head_commit.message:
fix(windows): resolve sandbox race conditions and stabilize concurrency

- Implemented named mutexes for sandbox refresh and elevated setup
- Orchestrator now skips redundant refreshes instead of colliding
- Cleaned up named mutex logic for reuse across sandbox components
- Verified fix resolves 'exit code 1' reported in issue #10601 when running alongside dev servers like Bun
